description: Version updates for the pnpm catalogs in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
Dependabot keeps security updates and GitHub Actions; see .github/dependabot.yml.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 lacks the programmatic API Astro, MDX and typescript-eslint need (docs/dependency-security.md).
Each site generation pins its own Lumen release; these move by hand with a visual review.
A new browser build can shift screenshot baselines, so Playwright gets its own pull request.
Vitest, its UI and V8 coverage must stay on one version.
Astro and its integrations are reviewed together because the archived sites share the catalog.
Everything else arrives as one monthly pull request.
